spark_open.description: The creature is a slender, four-legged equine animal shown in strict right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. Its coat is a uniform light to medium brown with a paler cream-white underbelly, inner legs, and muzzle, and darker brown shading along the back, lower legs, and joints. It has a long, narrow head with a white nose and mouth area, a dark eye, and two large upright ears, a short stiff dark brown mane along the top of the neck, a lean torso with visible musculature and skin folds at the neck and chest, four straight slender legs ending in single hooves standing on a flat surface with faint shadows, and a thin hanging tail with a dark hair tuft at the tip.
